name: Unidentified OOM-series security droid corporal
description: This unidentified OOM security battle droid was sighted on the Saak'ak in the events immediately prior to the Invasion of Naboo. It held the rank of corporal. It was destroyed, along with its commanding officer, OWO-1, after Jedi Knights Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi survived an assassination attempt via dioxis gas.
